messages.content: 我如何找到給定動量的力角度？

function.name: calculate_vector_angle
function.description: Calculate the angle of a vector based on its X and Y components. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

X_component.description: The X component of the vector. This is a float type value.

Y_component.description: The Y component of the vector. This is a float type value.

use_degrees.description: If true, the result will be in degrees. If false, the result will be in radians. Default is false.

message.content: 請告訴我該向量（或力）的 X 分量和 Y 分量，我就能幫你計算它的角度。

They might want to compute the angle of a vector given its components. The tool can calculate vector angle from X and Y components. So we need to ask for X and Y components or use the tool. We should respond with a question asking for X and Y components. Then call the function. But we need to ask for X and Y components first. So we ask: "請提供向量的 X 和 Y 分量，我可以為您計算角度。"

We then call the function with those values. But we don't have them yet. So we ask for them.
